retained_run_observations.boundary: This establishes post-sandbox inventory rejection, not the rejected path/type or sandboxed tool result. Wrapper child_exit 1 is not a GNATprove exit status.

source_evidence.finding: inventory sorts base.rglob('*'), enforces ENTRY_LIMIT, caches path.lstat(), then rejects path.is_symlink() or not(path.is_file() or path.is_dir()). Classification does not use the cached lstat mode.
source_evidence.implication: Fresh path observations can disagree with lstat if an entry disappears or changes; this error alone does not prove a nonregular entry existed.

source_evidence.finding: inside mounts private RAM/restore trees, creates tmp/cache, binds RAM tmp/cache onto TMPDIR/XDG_CACHE_HOME, copies chunk object directories, inventories seeds, calls sandbox(), then inventories RAM before saving output-inventory/inside-result.
source_evidence.implication: Seed inventory passed and sandbox() returned before rejection. Returned status was not persisted because the later inventory raised.

source_evidence.finding: bwrap uses --die-with-parent, --unshare-pid, --unshare-net, read-only root bind, proc/dev setup and RAM binds. stdout/stderr are in RAM. The subprocess starts a new session and has a 180-second wait bound with own-group kill on timeout.
source_evidence.implication: Source permits completion or timeout. Retained evidence does not establish which occurred.
